title: Karta pobytu waiting times in Poland, by voivodeship office (edition November 2026)
source: Written replies of voivodeship offices to public-information requests sent by Expat Essentials Poland on 7 Oct 2026 (letters dated 8–22 Oct 2026)
caveats: Averages of finished cases as reported by each office, not medians
Offices compute averages differently (e.g. Rzeszów includes refusals and discontinued cases)
Pending-case counts have different dates and scopes; do not sum them
